quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy III's defensive stance and positioning
quotes.excerpt: It's always back straight, but it's in this like lightning bolt, Z position.

text_blocks.speaker: Trey Murphy III's trainer
text_blocks.text: One of the big things that he struggled with earlier this week when we were looking at everything is he was in good position here, and when he went, his first thing he did was head down and his back was curled. We were talking about this is what the position is. It's always back straight, but it's in this like lightning bolt, Z position.

quotes.speaker: Trey Murphy III's trainer
quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy III's driving and contact management
quotes.excerpt: Your first dribble is to beat him, your second dribble is to just get connected.

text_blocks.speaker: Trey Murphy III's trainer
text_blocks.text: One of the things like Trey's guarding me, one of the things he kept trying to do, and he felt like he was like I'm getting too deep in the paint, but he would go here and he'd beat me, then he'd beat me again here, but now I was off of his body. So when he tried to bump me, say he's right there, he was going like this and I get to just stick him because I'm planted. And so now what I was telling him is I said, your first dribble is to beat him, your second dribble is to just get connected.

text_blocks.speaker: Trey Murphy III
text_blocks.text: So if I'm right here and I beat him here, I need to get connected. Now I'm here. Now I can get to the step back.

quotes.summary_phrase: Trey Murphy III on player brand and storytelling
quotes.excerpt: These brands need to see us and our value and what we've done to get to where we are.
quotes.quote: There's a lot of people that listen to what we have to say and so, you know, we have our own stories and the ways that we have, you know, grown up and these brands need to see us and our value and what we've done to get to where we are and not just look at us as, you know, a transaction.
